title: C4OS Grill Question 018 - Plugin Dependencies

answer_key.What should happen when enabling a plugi: Block enablement until the user manually enables dependencies

questions.label: Where should C4OS app plugin dependencies be declared?
questions.help: Recommended: `agents/c4os.yaml`, because dependencies affect C4OS shell activation and Settings states rather than Codex package installation.
options: Both, with Codex package dependencies in plugin.json and C4OS app dependencies in c4os.yaml

questions.label: What should happen when enabling a plugin with a disabled dependency?
questions.help: Recommended: show dependency requirement and offer to enable required dependencies together. This fits IDE requiring FS.
options: Show requirement and offer to enable dependencies together
Block enablement until the user manually enables dependencies
Allow enablement but mark the plugin inactive until dependencies are active

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify version constraints, optional dependencies, circular dependencies, or whether dependencies apply to tools, views, settings, or all plugin behavior.
